name: Anneliese Corrick
focus: Adults, preventive care, blood pressure and diabetes
summary: Founding physician. Long visits for ongoing conditions and annual physicals.
body:
Dr. Corrick opened Kellisford Family Medicine in 2009 after ten years in a hospital clinic.

She keeps Wednesday afternoons for longer follow-up visits.

name: Tomas Healey-Arden
focus: Adults and teens, sports and work injuries
summary: Joint and back pain, sports physicals and minor procedures in the office.
body: Dr. Healey-Arden joined in 2014. He does minor procedures in the office on Thursday mornings.

name: Odalys Brennick
focus: Children from age 2, teens and parents
summary: Well-child visits, school and sports forms, and sick visits for children.
body: Dr. Brennick sees families together when she can and keeps early-morning slots for children with fevers.

name: Priya Nandakumar
focus: Same-day sick visits, women's health, ongoing care
summary: Runs most same-day sick visits and the Saturday morning clinic.
body: Priya joined in 2019 and leads the Saturday morning clinic.

name: Marcus Teague
focus: Skin concerns, minor injuries, adult sick visits
summary: Rashes, minor injuries and adult sick visits.
body: Marcus is not taking new patients at this time but sees established patients for same-day visits.

name: Joan Whitlock
focus: Vaccines, lab draws, blood pressure checks, nurse visits
summary: Vaccines, lab draws and blood pressure checks without a provider visit.
body: Joan runs the nurse-visit schedule: vaccines, lab draws, blood pressure checks and injections.

name: Dess Marlowe
focus: Front desk, scheduling, records and referrals
summary: Front desk, records requests and referrals.
body: Dess trains the front desk and owns the phone script. Records requests start here.
